label: sdc01_0010_bbteacher_01
text: Hm? Are you...? Oh, you must be![VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: sdc01_0010_bbteacher_02
text: You’re one of the students chosen for the school\ntrip, aren’t you? And your name was...?[VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: sdc01_0010_bbteacher_03
text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)], huh?\c\nWell, aren’t you full of fire. You’re positively\ndazzling![VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: sdc01_0010_bbteacher_04
text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)], huh?\c\nWell, aren’t you a polite one. You’re positively\ndazzling![VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: sdc01_0010_bbteacher_05
text: Oh, and you even have a Tera Orb![VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: sdc01_0010_bbteacher_06
text:
I guess Paldea is rich enough in resources for that
sort of thing to be a common sight at school...\c
Unless that’s not the case? Are you perhaps an
especially exceptional student?[VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: sdc01_0010_bbteacher_07
text: Oh, but here I go on and on, and I haven’t even\nintroduced myself! Call me—[VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: sdc01_0010_ecology_01
text: Ms. Briiiar! I’m so sorry I’m late![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: sdc01_0010_ecology_02
text: Oh, hello to you too, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]!\c\nWhat a lucky scamp you are, getting to take part\nin a school trip so soon after transferring here![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: sdc01_0010_ecology_03
text: I sure am happy for you! I wish I could go too...[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: sdc01_0010_ecology_04
text: Huh? Oh! I’m sorry, Ms. Briar. I got a bit carried\naway...[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: sdc01_0010_bbteacher_09
text: Well, as Mr. Jacq so kindly stated for me, my\nname is Briar.\c\nI’m a teacher over at Blueberry Academy.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc01_0010_ecology_05
text: That’s a school in the Unova region, you know.\nMs. Briar helps set the curriculum there.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: sdc01_0010_bbteacher_10
text: This year is Blueberry Academy’s turn to run our\njoint school trip and supervise the students.\r\nThat’s why I came here to collect you.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc01_0010_bbteacher_11
text:
We’ll be heading to Kitakami, a land known for
its picturesque fields and rice paddies.\c
The place has a rustic feel, but there’s also
something rather mysterious about it.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc01_0010_bbteacher_12
text: You see, the same energy present in Paldea’s\nTerastal phenomenon has been detected there![VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc01_0010_bbteacher_13
text: I’m hoping to do some digging into the matter\nmyself—in between my supervising duties.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc01_0010_bbteacher_14
text: Though I’d ALSO appreciate the chance to take a\ngood look around the Great Crater of Paldea...[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc01_0010_ecology_06
text: Ah yes, well, there’s...not much I can do about\nthat without permission from the Pokémon\r\nLeague and Director Clavell...[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: sdc01_0010_bbteacher_15
text: Oh, I know.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc01_0010_bbteacher_16
text: I’ve already put in all the proper applications.\nI trust that I’ll get a favorable response soon?[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc01_0010_ecology_07
text: Ah...well... Hmmm...[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: sdc01_0010_ecology_08
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Oh! Sorry, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]! Forgot all
about
you
for
a
moment
there![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: sdc01_0010_ecology_09
text: Anyway, the school trip. Think of it as a chance to\ncontinue your Treasure Hunt on a grander scale—\r\nto search BEYOND Paldea’s borders![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: sdc01_0010_ecology_10
text: I’ll even provide you with a special update to\nyour Pokédex app. If you’d get out your phone?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: sdc01_0010_system_01
text: The [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Kitakami Pokédex[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] has been added to\nyour Pokédex app!

label: sdc01_0010_ecology_11
text: And there we go! All done!\c\nNow you can go wild registering all the Pokémon\nyou find around Kitakami too![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: sdc01_0010_ecology_12
text: Oh, and don’t worry about a permission slip for\nthe trip—I already cleared things with your mom!\r\nYou just go and have fun![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: sdc01_0010_bbteacher_17
text: Haha! Your Mr. Jacq is quite charming, isn’t he?\nDelightfully direct when he wants to be.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc01_0010_bbteacher_18
text: Now then, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]...\c\nIt’s quite a trip to the land of Kitakami. I hope\nyou don’t mind flying. Or long bus rides.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc01_0010_bbteacher_19
text: Let me know as soon as you’re ready to set out,\nwon’t you?[VAR 0x0114(0042)]
